title: GET 0UT
description:
This game WILL challenge you as it requires an Intermediate level of problem solving and it forces you to face your fears

A puzzle-solving horror game about an Unknown person who cannot remember his past and finds himself in a never-ending cycle, trying to find the answers about who he is and why is he suffering in this unknown place,

Solve the puzzles, uncover the secrets, defeat the enemies, and do your best to Get Out of this house of misery,

-Game mechanics that you need to know before playing the game: 

Fear is only in your mind, face your fears before losing yourself ☝🏻:

there is always a chance to fight back, anything that can kill you can also be killed 
 you can always find a way to counter the unkillable monsters, 
warning!! not facing them may result in trauma

a way to not forget yourself ☝🏻:

there is a book in the game that is cursed, you may restart your loop but the book will always keep its memories, use it to write information that you may not be able to memorize or might lose after each loop, can you trust a cursed book ?

how to open locked doors☝🏻 :

opening the locked doors requires keys, in order to use a key you need to press G to go in your inventory, hover on the correct key for the door and then press F to use it 

someone is trying to help you ☝🏻?

some of the items that can help you advance in the game are glowing and also glow in the dark,
 not all of them behave the same so you need to search well

if you cant handle it you can always willingly go to sleep☝🏻:

if you die in the game you will mysteriously go to the start of your loop.
 but you are not as powerless as you think, going to bed will result in restarting your loop

your time in the loop is finite☝🏻: 
 
you die if you wonder for too long, why ? there are bombs around the house that you need to locate and disarm so you can GET 0UT of the house, in order to defuse the bombs you need to find a defuse kit and cut the right wire, 
cutting a wrong wire will result in death which means restarting your loop, how to use the defuse kit ? same as opening a locked door with a key, press G go on the defuse kit and press F then click on the wire you want to cut 

 

Multiple Endings☝🏻: 
 
To uncover the full story and unlock the true ending, you’ll need to explore every corner, learn every secret, and master every challenge. But don’t get too comfortable, each playthrough brings new surprises, shifting elements, and unexpected changes that keep you on your toes. you’ll receive the full game, including all possible endings but remember not everything ends the way it seems
